'''Sint Yoru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Nakia Yoru]]. Together, the couple were employed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]]. While attempting to kill [[Cade Skywalker]], Skywalker killed Sint.

==Biography==
===The last hunt===
{{Quote|Nakia will never forgive me.''"<br />"''Why? For dying in the sand like a gornt?|Sint Yoru and Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 40" />}}
'''Sint Yoru''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], was the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Nakia Yoru]].<ref name="Legacy 38" /> Sint, Nakia, and the [[Blood Carver]] [[Ku Vrat]] were tasked by [[Lun Rask]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] both [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Gunn Yage]] at the behest of [[Nieve Gromia]], the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="Legacy 37" /> Nakia and Sint tracked Skywalker and Yage to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and then followed their targets into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. The bounty hunters found their targets in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. They proceeded to fire on Skywalker and Yage, but the pair managed to escape into the desert under approaching [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]. When Sint asked Nakia about purposely missing her shots, she responded that she needed to consume Skywalker's [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]. Sint agreed to take Yage's and leave Skywalker to her.<ref name="Legacy 38" />

Later, Sint and Nakia went to the wreckage of their prey's speeder and a fight broke out between Sint and Ku Vrat over who had lost the targets. After the fight came to a draw,<ref name="Legacy 38" /> the three bounty hunters waited out the sandstorm in a ship. When they emerged to track Skywalker and Yage again, the Anzati had found their prey asleep at the abandoned [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. Sint used the opportunity to take [[Kol Skywalker's lightsaber|Cade's lightsaber]], then prepared to consume Yage's soup while Nakia was about to consume Skywalker's. However, Skywalker awakened prematurely and kicked her before using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|throw]] her off of him. Sint tried to psychically assault Skywalker but the two men ended up grappling with each other.<ref name="Legacy 39">[[Legacy (2006) 39|''Legacy'' (2006) 39]]</ref> Sint recovered and brandished a lightsaber that was obtained by hunting and killing a Jedi. The Anzati grazed Skywalker's armor with it, but Skywalker used summoned his own lightsaber back and killed Sint with one strike, as Sint was no match for his skill with [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="Legacy 40" />
